author: Kusha N M

lines: ನಿನ್ನ ನಡೆನುಡಿ ತಿರುಗಿ ನಿನ ಬಳಿಗೆ ಬರುತಿಹವು

raw:
ತನ್ನೊಳಿಹ ಭಗವಂತ ತನಗೆಂದು ಕಾಣಿಸನು
ತನ್ನಂತೆ ಬಗೆದಿರುವ ಇತರರಲಿ ಕಾಣ್ವ
ನಿನ್ನ ನಡೆನುಡಿ ತಿರುಗಿ ನಿನ ಬಳಿಗೆ ಬರುತಿಹವು
ನಿನ್ನಂತೆ ಪರರ ಬಗೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: The God within you will never show himself to you alone;
you see him in others who feel as you do;
your words and deeds come back around to you,
so think of others as you think of yourself, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: We find the Divine not by looking inward alone but by seeing it in others. What we give comes back to us, so treat others as we would ourselves.
